target_customer: RCM companies, orthopedic practices, rural hospitals and other healthcare providers
problem: Healthcare back offices do eligibility checks, prior authorization, claims and appeals by hand across EHRs and payer portals; Clicks agents operate those screens.
business_model: B2B services plus software, implementations in 5 weeks or less; pricing not stated
product_category: AI agents for healthcare revenue cycle back office

founders.name: Dominik Helmreich
education: ETH Zurich, computer science and engineering

founders.name: Oliver Knapp
previous_startups: Earlier AI startup, name and outcome not stated on YC page
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built 10 plus enterprise AI applications in two years

competitors.name: Thoughtful AI
competitors.what: Team of AI agents for revenue cycle management, launched November 2024 after a 20M raise in July 2024

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that drive EHRs, payer portals and legacy desktop apps with human review and audit trails, plus HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II compliance; hard parts are reliability and compliance.

defensibility.rationale: Compliance and workflow integration help, but well funded rivals such as Thoughtful AI and Waystar launched similar agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Waystar, Commure and others launched RCM agents; no action against Clicks found.

market_need_then: RCM is large and labor heavy; the site cites an orthopedic group cutting admin denials by 24 percent and winning 50 percent more appeals (company claims).

branding.domain_note: Uses clickshealth.com and goclicks.ai per aggregator listings

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with Clicks Group in South Africa and others; no brand press found.

pivots.from: Back office automation for recruiting and exec search firms (earlier YC launch post per search results)
pivots.to: AI agents for healthcare RCM back office

outcome_analysis: Clicks Health is a Fall 2025 company founded by two ETH Zurich graduates that sells AI agents to RCM firms and practices, with named customers and investors on its site. Round sizes are not verified; the company looks early with credible backers in a crowded RCM agent market.
notes: Company site lists investors Y Combinator, Fly Ventures, Yellow VC, 20VC and Calm/Storm but no amounts or dates, so no round is recorded. Dealroom shows over 4.5M raised and a 125K seed; CB Insights shows 500K; all unverified and conflicting. Pivot from recruiting back office is from a search snippet only; the YC launch post was not read. Completeness pass: the $500K seed (2025-09-29) rests on a single database (Seedtable), with CB Insights also showing 500K total. Dealroom shows a 125K seed and a claim of over 4.5M raised; both conflict and are not recorded. Y Combinator is listed as an investor by CB Insights.
